task.ques: Identify a Coursera course on artificial intelligence ethics that has a duration of less than 20 hours to complete and has been rated 4+ stars by participants.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Artificial Intelligence: Ethics & Societal Challenges, offered by Lund University on Coursera, meets the requirements: its displayed schedule is 1 week at 10 hours a week (about 10 hours, under 20), and its participant rating is 4.7/5 from 433 reviews.
Source: https://www.coursera.org/learn/ai-ethics
Verified October 27, 2026. Evidence: final.png shows the course title, duration schedule, rating and review count together.
